Boss.Name: Red Dragon Invasion
Boss.Description1: A Red Dragon is approaching the city.
Boss.Description2: Drive back the invasion before it is too late.

Boss.Name: Medusa
Boss.Description1: Medusa has appeared in the Swamp of Calm.
Boss.Description2: Defeat her before the invasion time expires.

Boss.Name: Selupan
Boss.Description1: Selupan awaits challengers inside the Raklion Hatchery.
Boss.Description2: Its status is read directly from the Raklion battle.

Boss.Name: Nightmare
Boss.Description1: Nightmare commands the final battle of Kanturu.
Boss.Description2: A Moonstone Pendant is required by the native event.

Boss.Name: Kundun
Boss.Description1: Kundun rules the deepest floor of Kalima.
Boss.Description2: The panel reports whether the real Kalima 7 boss is alive.
